Italian drinking culture centers on moderation, food pairing, and socializing rather than binge drinking or getting drunk . Drinks are typically tied to specific times of day and meals.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12sUsEM9GavlZhnFP45zb1FKQItPn1dAZPuqMb85onXhZ0gpi85gdxITbCtk77NJAxmExrxCPfZ2OXVlQBfhPi4ck1WfIsuh5kThEZN9pdHqrPfF758yW-rXeG1Rf1gzuKd_Xv16W-bch_nFDvECbR42u8KQmWnFPyxwcF26CX3q6elE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zVVO15C9l4l1cn34ERMddEnmhLi0LOTUUK3muOkEpkdLuKt2WNpkL0h1iSJDtendOykloNAQ56n3r2Er9gdmMhIjnemYhVGa2JQtsVXqw5b44gLHMssvOvq6o1sNNk0BU81X-2LoWyhe0MdoJqmzwNLhx8HqrQMDCzmt3UnlhkWSJhSR50vhAbGozw9g3w)

### Daily Drinking Rhythm

- **Morning:** Espresso (*caffè* ) or cappuccino is standard; alcohol is uncommon. Cappuccinos are generally avoided after morning.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zVVO15C9l4l1cn34ERMddEnmhLi0LOTUUK3muOkEpkdLuKt2WNpkL0h1iSJDtendOykloNAQ56n3r2Er9gdmMhIjnemYhVGa2JQtsVXqw5b44gLHMssvOvq6o1sNNk0BU81X-2LoWyhe0MdoJqmzwNLhx8HqrQMDCzmt3UnlhkWSJhSR50vhAbGozw9g3w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXbt1TEbEK35AAKCjFBc4lC7dPuR_keWyeWEYl2kI1v7txqDJoiAK0qP1c4hLvlxbH4qLOiLKhKk-n8kxg9_HLkt9H299jRUqjzEXsrWpJGEjCBITTgd5RLt8ljQNN-_-CcOz7)
- **Aperitivo (roughly 6:00 PM–8:30 PM):** A social pre-dinner ritual featuring light or bitter drinks alongside small bites like olives, chips, or regional snacks (*cicchetti* in Venice).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXpT_W_LMAk3YIMNbAssb2N1hXtMhOu5RmrioXplZfIfcYAMP7tvBwa-Zq2rhMjhtLcRN3va_l60_12JfWg8yqMF1GCHoMeHh599si_zIVVECzlLPcnRVM3Tc8TCWTir0s_ewcePbqwMSwpscAIz-_RQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzwEBxCJF1w3yisG6dcl2eH8fCSZU3Dr1CgyE895SD0NBVk7Tj-5UD3vMBrrslIxHpAS2UL4zxdH_ydLaKO5yaB8Kd_UzwFPxrs882nx5_lPy1vgBPPOSO7vW-RuI78PQoWOWNukHvlcYBCwtLRDXn4pOU0zxIc4mRe9xQq0DVWs95EOBRYVMyBtzQOhkNht_pq_bgNO28p69GNnnjHFqymWHSN2stqSeEg_5mVx3tYF4l_zBQbh0JXNtFKaNUQtF08QyWghzFc9fO6dQBewBalQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX9Mrvh_tMJ_BYK0BaOvu0pJmE6_E1Xe8kgIISUlBkM2XL4XKMKhNG-ezR0VvMNR2cQXEgGQ7LmEC0OfIE7kSO3RbkgWuww5_-_NVd9xWQnbHt-PpxB5j2T65mnp-drmyCM7eX)
- **Meals:** Wine is the classic pairing for lunch and dinner, while beer often accompanies pizza . Cocktails are generally not drunk with meals.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12sUsEM9GavlZhnFP45zb1FKQItPn1dAZPuqMb85onXhZ0gpi85gdxITbCtk77NJAxmExrxCPfZ2OXVlQBfhPi4ck1WfIsuh5kThEZN9pdHqrPfF758yW-rXeG1Rf1gzuKd_Xv16W-bch_nFDvECbR42u8KQmWnFPyxwcF26CX3q6elE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF11SWlq3d2y2Qov4lwmo2esoVutAo0MnCRl3sLUdf8Vhm9faMMRhNlabosaywB1rb38FgZoncM9_O6lxR-cl9H18BUQmW5BhUDpbsvvI8Bhn-im_Xldt8WXHUHk-gv9XQakgizODigdbemiy2amXKauVfiaKh0qeg2aENF69WGlxBhhkCAhQggXOIY2cBRA5AXZ4qZTArWA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)
- **Digestivo (after dinner):** Herbal or bitter liqueurs (*amari* ), grappa, or limoncello are sipped after eating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXpT_W_LMAk3YIMNbAssb2N1hXtMhOu5RmrioXplZfIfcYAMP7tvBwa-Zq2rhMjhtLcRN3va_l60_12JfWg8yqMF1GCHoMeHh599si_zIVVECzlLPcnRVM3Tc8TCWTir0s_ewcePbqwMSwpscAIz-_RQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)

### Key Drinks & Etiquette

- **Aperitivo & Cocktails:** Spritzes (such as Aperol or Campari), Negronis, vermouth , and non-alcoholic bitters like Crodino or Sanbitter.
- **Wine & Beer:** Regional wines and house table wine (*vino della casa* ) are staples, alongside lagers (like Peroni or Moretti ) and a growing craft beer scene.
- **Social Norms:** Sipping slowly and holding conversation is valued over chugging or public intoxication. The legal drinking age is 18.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX9Mrvh_tMJ_BYK0BaOvu0pJmE6_E1Xe8kgIISUlBkM2XL4XKMKhNG-ezR0VvMNR2cQXEgGQ7LmEC0OfIE7kSO3RbkgWuww5_-_NVd9xWQnbHt-PpxB5j2T65mnp-drmyCM7eX)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXpT_W_LMAk3YIMNbAssb2N1hXtMhOu5RmrioXplZfIfcYAMP7tvBwa-Zq2rhMjhtLcRN3va_l60_12JfWg8yqMF1GCHoMeHh599si_zIVVECzlLPcnRVM3Tc8TCWTir0s_ewcePbqwMSwpscAIz-_RQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12sUsEM9GavlZhnFP45zb1FKQItPn1dAZPuqMb85onXhZ0gpi85gdxITbCtk77NJAxmExrxCPfZ2OXVlQBfhPi4ck1WfIsuh5kThEZN9pdHqrPfF758yW-rXeG1Rf1gzuKd_Xv16W-bch_nFDvECbR42u8KQmWnFPyxwcF26CX3q6elE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzwEBxCJF1w3yisG6dcl2eH8fCSZU3Dr1CgyE895SD0NBVk7Tj-5UD3vMBrrslIxHpAS2UL4zxdH_ydLaKO5yaB8Kd_UzwFPxrs882nx5_lPy1vgBPPOSO7vW-RuI78PQoWOWNukHvlcYBCwtLRDXn4pOU0zxIc4mRe9xQq0DVWs95EOBRYVMyBtzQOhkNht_pq_bgNO28p69GNnnjHFqymWHSN2stqSeEg_5mVx3tYF4l_zBQbh0JXNtFKaNUQtF08QyWghzFc9fO6dQBewBalQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zVVO15C9l4l1cn34ERMddEnmhLi0LOTUUK3muOkEpkdLuKt2WNpkL0h1iSJDtendOykloNAQ56n3r2Er9gdmMhIjnemYhVGa2JQtsVXqw5b44gLHMssvOvq6o1sNNk0BU81X-2LoWyhe0MdoJqmzwNLhx8HqrQMDCzmt3UnlhkWSJhSR50vhAbGozw9g3w)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF1_TnbZX3ai7Gb0zQlO2DtlInCIOaotuVgOqH7lenGwC5wXvFe5mQh9v-aOVhXUyBa6cB6MEM6NKWSJ8nVazbmVkAosEC8MoK7W4thMJF6_Rsq7zkkeZ7VPF_MIYEk-1juktseorEBmi4jiB4tSTL8F4Mw7Hyhs6KK9A2MQ3sawDXN8sJQWhoAgFeByTRHsInbqovR5YqaXSzJShgyVb9zntlBlY)

A single user on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF11SWlq3d2y2Qov4lwmo2esoVutAo0MnCRl3sLUdf8Vhm9faMMRhNlabosaywB1rb38FgZoncM9_O6lxR-cl9H18BUQmW5BhUDpbsvvI8Bhn-im_Xldt8WXHUHk-gv9XQakgizODigdbemiy2amXKauVfiaKh0qeg2aENF69WGlxBhhkCAhQggXOIY2cBRA5AXZ4qZTArWA) noted that regional habits typically involve one or two glasses of wine or beer with meals and a small glass of spirits for special occasions. items.markdown:
- **Aperitivo & Cocktails:** Spritzes (such as Aperol or Campari), Negronis, vermouth , and non-alcoholic bitters like Crodino or Sanbitter.
- **Wine & Beer:** Regional wines and house table wine (*vino della casa* ) are staples, alongside lagers (like Peroni or Moretti ) and a growing craft beer scene.
- **Social Norms:** Sipping slowly and holding conversation is valued over chugging or public intoxication.
